title: fix(comments): Reply focuses the reply box, author avatars with initials, mention menu at the caret, delete toast

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuRdCovTRVz9Jix7ehp9bq4j)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgU81jVj4Jk1kQNvLJ5

Fixes #36070

## What changes

Four small fixes to comments (epic #36062, phase 1), made in the shared pieces so the comment panel of #36075 carries them over:

1. **Reply puts the caret in the reply box.** `ThreadedReplies` takes a new optional `focusReplyOnOpen` prop: each time its reply input opens, it expands the replies (when collapsed) and focuses the input. `RecordActivityTimeline` passes it behind its Reply button. Default `false`, so a host that always shows the input does not have every thread pull focus on mount.
2. **Author avatar, 20 px.** New `CommentAuthorAvatar` (exported from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`): the author's image, or their initials on the same `Avatar` / `AvatarFallback` disc the people-field chips and `PersonRow` draw, with the same `getPersonInitials` (now exported from `@object-ui/fields`). It replaces the comment icon on every comment and the hand-drawn first-letter disc on every reply.
3. **Mention menu at the caret.** `RichTextCommentInput` measures the caret with a mirror element (`textareaCaret.ts`) and opens the menu under the caret's line, or above it when the window has no room below (menu taller than the space under the line, and more space above). Where layout cannot be measured, it keeps its old place over the editor's top left. Candidates and notifications are unchanged.
4. **Delete toast.** The record page's `handleDeleteComment` shows a success toast "Comment deleted" (zh 评论已删除) after the server deleted the row. A refused delete keeps its error toast. New key `detail.commentDeleted` in all eleven locale packs.

Not changed: where comments sit and how they are structured (#36075 / #36076).

**For #36075 to reuse:** `CommentAuthorAvatar` (avatar/initials), `ThreadedReplies`' `focusReplyOnOpen` (pass `true` wherever the reply input opens behind a Reply button), the mention placement inside `RichTextCommentInput` (comes with the component), and the delete toast in the host's `handleDeleteComment` (comes with the handler).

## Why

Measured on main in the showcase (account record, Activity tab, 1312 wide): after Reply, focus stayed on the Reply button, so typing went nowhere; on a comment with a collapsed reply, Reply showed the input but not the reply; comments without an avatar showed a comment icon; the mention menu opened at the editor's top left; a delete showed nothing.

## Verification

- New `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/commentSmallFixes-36070.test.tsx` (10 tests): focus and expand on Reply, a CONTROL that the default does not pull focus, initials (Latin and CJK) on comment and reply, the menu below / above / clamped to the box / fallback when unmeasurable.
- `RecordDetailView.feedCommentEditDelete-12268.test.tsx`: the delete now also asserts the success toast; Cancel and a refused delete assert none.
- Local: `plugin-detail` suite 3660 passed; `i18n` + `fields` 5050 passed; `plugin-detail` type-check clean; eslint on the touched files clean of new warnings.
- Browser, showcase on a fresh console build, before = main `493ad095`, after = this branch. Focus read from `document.activeElement` after Reply: before `BUTTON Reply`, after `INPUT Reply…`; typed text lands in the reply input. Delete: before no toast, after "Comment deleted".
